scope: Identifier-resolved public herb chemistry and molecular evidence retrieval; no clinical efficacy or whole-herb binding probability

data.crosswalk: Active SymMap v2.0 explicit TCMSP_id/PubChem_CID; exact existing TCMSP herb membership; ambiguous or missing CID excluded, no name guessing
data.structures: PubChem CID property records; validate SMILES/InChIKey; standardized isomeric parent comparison; no connectivity-only joins. Before any test evaluation, additionally reject conflicting molecular-weight paths (tolerance max1Da,0.5%) and parseable elemental-formula conflicts; see identity_amendment.json. Original TCMSP stereostructures not independently retrieved.
data.affinity: Reuse hash-verified ChEMBL37 measured Ki/Kd snapshot (468 rows) from v3; no new independent affinity cohort. Live ChEMBL endpoints were returning HTTP500/timeouts during this round; retain provenance and an audited extension path.
data.measurement_filter: Human SINGLE PROTEIN, binding assay confidence9, exact positive nM Ki/Kd; standard_flag1; exclude quality flags, potential duplicates and annotated mutations; exclude aggregated replicate range >1 pK in v5 integration

affinity_model.model: Ridge alpha10,solver lsqr,tol1e-6; fixed from v3 development
affinity_model.evaluation: Leave global shared-document/structure/scaffold connected component out. Min40 training rows/fold. Report all skipped rows and coverage. Reused data and prior hyperparameter choice make results exploratory.
affinity_model.deployment_gate: LOCO MAE below fold training-mean MAE; >=30 held-out rows,>=3 held-out components; at least40 fit rows. Not an independent confirmation of predictive performance.
affinity_model.uncertainty: 90th percentile absolute out-of-component error; descriptive error band, not conformal or calibrated coverage. Predictions only for non-observed structures and similarity>=0.5; use lower band bound for ranking. Missing remains masked, never a negative training label.

molecular_score.transform: clip((pK-4)/5,0,1), engineering monotonic affinity-evidence index, not binding probability; Ki/Kd separate columns
molecular_score.herb_aggregation: Maximum supported constituent index per target/endpoint; preserve winner and all supporting records. No concentration, bioavailability, synergy or action-direction inference.
molecular_score.set_aggregation: Maximum index across selected herbs per target/endpoint, then mean over requested target/endpoint columns with any supported evidence. Report missing requested columns separately.
molecular_score.objective: (1-w)*old evidence objective + w*molecular index - w*0.02*herb_count; w=0.35 default, thus total herb cost remains0.02. Independent disease-research target context, not invented symptom-target edges. Evaluate w=0 ablation, measured_only ablation.
molecular_score.missingness: Zero numeric storage always accompanied by observed/predicted masks; absent target columns excluded from molecular denominator; unknown herb-cell means no evidence credit, not weak binding

planning.queries: New hash-selected symptom groups excluding published v1/v2/v4 requests; 160 train,40validation,80test base groups, two engineering profiles per group (budget8 or4 with2 exclusions and2 forbidden pairs). Not patient data or pharmacological contraindications.
planning.targets: All three explicit research targets in primary comparison; each query retains target list. Runtime allows subsets and weights; their generalization is not claimed by the fixed-context experiment.
planning.selection: Validation objective; retain initial, warm and final candidates; tie earlier checkpoint. Choose deployment KAN variant/seed on validation only. Test after all selections saved. Expose raw KAN/PPO and explicit greedy guard separately.
planning.statistics: Paired symptom-group bootstrap, report objective,gap,hard constraints,chemistry coverage and action changes; no clinical interpretation
